qualifier: via PI3K, CDK5 and RAC1 branches
name: TrkB neurotrophin signaling via PI3K, CDK5 and RAC1
rationale: All members concern BDNF/NT-3 activation of NTRK2 (TrkB) and its downstream PI3K/AKT, CDK5 and RAC1 outputs, which separates it from the NGF/TrkA theme and from the TrkB theme built on FRS2, PLCG1 and RAS branches.

qualifier: in gastrulation and neural plate morphogenesis
name: Convergent extension in gastrulation and neural plate morphogenesis
rationale: Every member is a convergent-extension morphogenetic movement (axis elongation, gastrulation, organogenesis, neural plate shaping), distinct from planar-polarity establishment and neural plate patterning/fate themes.

core: Protein integrity defence under cellular stress
qualifier: damaged-protein repair and methylglyoxal detoxification
name: Damaged-protein repair and methylglyoxal stress defence
rationale: Members cover repair of damaged proteins, methylglyoxal (glycation) metabolism and responses to nitrosative and manganese stress with restraint of folding, CMA and mitochondrial targeting (a DJ-1-like protective profile), unlike confusables centred on aggrephagy, refolding, ROS detoxification or heat shock.

core: Great artery and pulmonary vascular development
qualifier: BMP-SMAD driven, including ductus arteriosus closure and lung blood pressure
name: BMP-driven great artery and pulmonary vascular development
rationale: Members combine BMP/SMAD signaling with pharyngeal arch, coronary and pulmonary artery morphogenesis, outflow tract septation, ductus closure and lung vascular pressure, distinguishing it from valve, endocardial cushion, endothelial identity and heart-field themes.

qualifier: with CENP-A centromeric chromatin assembly
name: Chromosome condensation and CENP-A centromeric chromatin assembly
rationale: Members are mitotic/meiotic chromosome condensation plus deposition of CENP-A nucleosomes at centromeres, separating it from general nucleosome assembly, histone acetylation and cohesion/spindle themes.

qualifier: regulating sleep-wake states, including orexin and opioid receptors
name: Neuropeptide and opioid signaling regulating sleep-wake states
rationale: Members combine neuropeptide/orexin and opioid GPCR signaling, dense-core vesicle release and nerve-impulse modulation with sleep/wake regulation, whereas confusables pair neuropeptides with mating, feeding, aggression or stress behaviors.

qualifier: Listeria invasion and SARS coronavirus targeting of host signaling
name: Listeria entry and SARS-CoV host signaling subversion
rationale: Members are Listeria/Gram-positive bacterial attachment and invasion and SARS-CoV-1/2 targeting of host junction PDZ proteins, signaling and cell death, unlike confusables on toxins, Mycobacterium phagosome manipulation or RSV protein maturation.

qualifier: adrenal-gonadal steroidogenesis, thyroid hormone and GH/prolactin/leptin
name: Adrenal-gonadal steroidogenesis, thyroid and GH-prolactin-leptin hormone signaling
rationale: Members span corticosteroid, sex-steroid and progesterone biosynthesis and secretion, thyroid hormone generation and signaling, and growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling, distinguishing it from vitamin A/D/K metabolism themes and a growth-rate/amino-acid transport theme.

qualifier: with lysosomal and Golgi enzyme trafficking
name: Glycolipid transport and lysosomal enzyme trafficking
rationale: Members cover glycosphingolipid, glycolipid and ceramide-1-phosphate transfer together with lysosome/endosome proteins, Golgi membrane genes and lysosomal enzyme secretion, unlike confusables centred on glycosphingolipid catabolism or biosynthesis or ER-Golgi phospholipid transfer.

core: Negative regulation of inflammatory cytokine production
qualifier: IL-1, IL-12 and Toll/IL-1 receptor signaling
name: Suppression of IL-1, IL-12 and Toll/IL-1R inflammatory signaling
rationale: Members restrain IL-1alpha/beta and IL-12 production and regulate Toll and IL-1-mediated signaling, distinguishing it from inflammasome/IL-1 processing and from IL-6/TNF/TLR4 suppression themes.

qualifier: social, vocal and sensorimotor, with amygdala and striatum development
name: Social, vocal and sensorimotor behavior with limbic-striatal development
rationale: Members are social, vocal, sensory-gating, exploratory and grooming behaviors plus amygdala/striatum development and MECP2-GABA regulation, an autism/Rett-relevant profile distinct from motor-coordination and MECP2 molecular-regulation themes.

qualifier: at telomeres (recombination, D-loops, t-circles) and reversed replication forks
name: Telomere recombination and replication fork DNA topology remodeling
rationale: Members concern DNA geometric/topological change during recombination-based telomere maintenance, D-loop disassembly, t-circle formation and fork reversal, unlike confusables on telomere capping/protection or R-loop and crosslink repair.

qualifier: driven by dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma
name: Th1 polarization via dendritic cell IL-12 and IFN-gamma
rationale: Members promote Th1 differentiation and responses through IL-12, IFN-gamma and GM-CSF production, dendritic cell cytokine output and MHC-II induction, unlike confusables on DC antigen presentation, downstream IFN-gamma/IL-12 JAK-STAT signaling or Treg/memory T cell fate.

qualifier: of tumor-suppressor targets CDKN1A, BIM and p14-ARF
name: RUNX3 control of growth-arrest and apoptosis genes
rationale: All members concern RUNX3 regulation and its transcriptional targets p21, BIM and p14-ARF, distinguishing it from TGF-beta receptor/SMAD cancer mutant, PAX3 and CDH1 transcription themes.

qualifier: bone maturation and tooth enamel and dentin
name: Bone and tooth enamel-dentin mineralization
rationale: Members regulate bone mineralization during maturation, chondrocyte development, enamel and dentin formation and tooth eruption (with SIBLING-type protein phosphorylation), distinct from odontoblast/cementum development and from systemic phosphate, vitamin D and FGF23-Klotho homeostasis themes.

core: Hemostasis: platelet activation, coagulation and fibrinolysis
qualifier: with integrin-Rap1 adhesion signaling
name: Platelet integrin-Rap1 activation, coagulation and fibrinolysis
rationale: Members span platelet receptor activation, adhesion and degranulation, the coagulation cascade and its factor defects, vitamin K-dependent carboxylation and fibrinolysis, plus integrin-Rap1/p130Cas adhesion signaling that separates it from the eicosanoid-extended, ECM, vascular smooth muscle and G12/13-Rho confusables.

qualifier: inherited factor VIII, IX and V variant defects
name: Factor VIII, IX and V variant defects in coagulation amplification
rationale: Nearly all members are disease variants of factors VIII, IX and V (hemophilia A/B-type and FV defects) within the intrinsic pathway and cascade amplification, distinct from confusables adding initiation, fibrin formation, fibrinolysis, contact-system or VWF defects.

qualifier: regulation of glutamate secretion
name: Presynaptic modulation of glutamate secretion and synaptic transmission
rationale: Members regulate glutamate secretion and presynaptically dampen glutamatergic and GABAergic transmission, whereas confusables centre on vesicle exocytosis machinery, presynaptic calcium/depolarization or G-protein channel inhibition.

qualifier: cytosolic enzymes ASS1, ASL and ARG1
name: Inherited deficiencies of cytosolic urea cycle enzymes
rationale: The three members are citrullinemia, argininosuccinic aciduria and hyperargininemia, the cytosolic ASS1-ASL-ARG1 steps, distinguishing it from confusables built on OTC/ornithine transporter defects, urea cycle biosynthesis and its transcriptional control.

qualifier: naive/resting circulating B cells
name: Naive resting B cell surface and transcript signatures
rationale: Members are blood B cell, naive B cell surface and generic lymphocyte expression modules, lacking the activation, germinal centre, plasma cell and memory B cell modules present in the confusables.

qualifier: with nuclear phosphoinositides and polyphosphate hydrolysis
name: Inositol pyrophosphate and nuclear phosphoinositide turnover
rationale: Members cover cytosolic inositol pyrophosphate synthesis, diphosphoinositol and diadenosine polyphosphate hydrolysis, and nuclear IP/PIP synthesis with PI5P-TP53 signaling, unlike confusables on nucleotide interconversion, ER-lumen IP synthesis or PTEN/AKT signaling.

qualifier: compartment-specific phosphoinositide synthesis and ER tubular network lipid transfer
name: Compartmental phosphoinositide synthesis and ER-network lipid transfer
rationale: Members combine PIP/IP synthesis at plasma membrane, Golgi, ER and endosomes with ER tubular network shaping, membrane contact lipid/cholesterol transfer and Miro (RHOT) cycles, distinguishing it from mitochondria-ER tethering, phosphatase regulation and phospholipid flippase themes.

qualifier: NR4A induction with NF-kB, PI3K-mTOR and p38 signatures
name: Immediate-early NR4A, NF-kB and PI3K-mTOR stimulus response
rationale: Members are growth factor/stimulus-induced programmes (NR4A early genes, TNF-NF-kB and PI3K-AKT-mTOR hallmarks, p38 activation, growth arrest), distinguished from UV-response, AP-1/FOSL and TAK1-JNK confusables.

qualifier: TRIF and IRAK2-TRAF6 routes to TAK1, cytokines and cell death
name: TLR TRIF/IRAK2-TAK1 signaling driving inflammatory cytokines and cell death
rationale: Members are TRIF/TICAM1- and IRAK2-TRAF6-mediated TAK1/IKK activation, TRIF-induced cell death and positive regulation of IL-6, IL-8 and TNF production, unlike confusables on broad NF-kB regulation, inflammasomes/LPS sensing, IRF3/7 endosomal TLR deficiencies or cytokine suppression.

qualifier: through UDP and UTP
name: De novo pyrimidine biosynthesis to UTP
rationale: All members describe de novo pyrimidine synthesis through UDP and UTP, distinct from pyrimidine catabolism/salvage, deoxyribonucleotide synthesis and purine biosynthesis confusables.
